title: PHD Weekly Performance Summary

sections.title: Volume & Throughput
sections.body: PHD received 728 incident reports (-11.3% WoW) and resolved 718 (-10.4% WoW), netting only 10 cases to the backlog — a 50% reduction WoW. SLA performance was 100% for cases created and resolved within the week, with MTD SLA at 98.9%.

sections.title: Quality — Repeat Incidents
sections.body: Repeat incidents dropped to 8 (-46.7% WoW), signaling improved first-contact resolution.

watch.label: Unsuccessful Outreach
watch.note: Remains an opportunity area. Customer and driver outreach — performed by LMIR — directly supports mitigating actions such as driver notes, delivery GEO pin updates, and parcel box instructions for low-severity incidents.

addressSentence: 12 address exclusions were processed (-52% WoW) alongside 4 GEO Pin updates (+100% WoW).
addressNote: GEO Pins are critical to setting accurate Road Entry Points (REP) and delivery points, ensuring transporters can complete deliveries safely via the Rabbit app.
